comparison.objective: Tune and lock a damper versus dial a three-wheel code and open a box.
comparison.physical_skill: Both use controlled rotary setting; candidate adds recessed-tool unlocking, counterholding, locking torque, and impact-driven iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires repeated non-bottoming stops and setting retention; record requires three wheels within 5 degrees of 3-1-7 and lid at least 60 degrees open.
comparison.reason: Rotary adjustment alone is a generic primitive; code entry does not test damping behavior or lock integrity. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain unspecified.
